sentences.en: The rescuers pulled out the young girl from the avalanche.
sentences.zh: 救援人员从雪崩中救出了那个小女孩。

sentences.en: The inhabitants of the Gizeldon Valley are used to avalanches.
sentences.zh: 吉泽登谷的居民习惯于应对雪崩。

sentences.en: Nobody knows just how many people died in the avalanche.
sentences.zh: 没人知道在那场雪崩中有多少人遇难。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：三个a像滚下的雪球→雪崩
